body.name: A^{\mathrm K}
body.def: For \(x\in\{0,1\}\), let \(\sigma_0=(4,2,3,1)\) and \(\sigma_1=(4,3,2,1)\), and define row \(h\) of \(A_x^{\mathrm K}(b)\) as \(\bigl(1,b_{\sigma_x(h)}(w_1),b_{\sigma_x(h)}(w_2),b_{\sigma_x(h)}(w_3)\bigr)\). This is the matrix \(A_x\) on page 12134 of Kawakami (2021), after converting its response-type order \((00,01,10,11)\) to the present labels.
body.role: Kawakami proxy-loading matrix used for the exact overlap and scope-separation check
